name: run_id
description: The run, shared by every stage it ran

name: pipeline
description: The pipeline's name

name: stage_name
description: The stage

name: stage_index
description: Its place in the pipeline, from 1

name: parser_name
description: The parser the stage pins

name: parser_version
description: Its version

name: parser_code_hash
description: Hash of the parser's module, so an edit without a version bump shows

name: code_version
description: The commit the code was built from

name: status
description: running, succeeded or failed; a stage's newest row is its state

name: trigger
description: What started the run: manual, schedule, ...

name: rerun_from_stage
description: The first stage of a run that did not start at the first stage

name: host
description: local, github-actions or cloud-run

name: trigger_context
description: The workflow run, job execution and machine that ran it

name: config
description: The stage's options, --force, --from, --to and every stage's pin

name: started_at
description: When the stage started

name: finished_at
description: When it ended; empty while running

name: logged_at
description: When this row was written

name: upstream_manifest_uri
description: The manifest of the stage run this one read

name: output_manifest_uri
description: This stage run's manifest

name: notes_uri
description: This stage run's notes.parquet, which stage_notes reads

name: notes_count
description: How many notes it wrote

name: items_total
description: Work items planned

name: items_succeeded
description: Items built or reused

name: items_cached
description: Items reused from an earlier run

name: items_failed
description: Items that failed

name: rows_out
description: Rows the items wrote, where they count rows

name: bytes_out
description: Bytes the items wrote

name: items
description: Each item: key, status, inputs, outputs, error

name: error_class
description: Why the stage could not start, when it could not
